description: A man with swept-back dark hair and a white cravat, wearing a dark greatcoat, stands at a window holding a bundle of loose manuscript pages against his chest. Through the window, a mounted rider in a cocked hat leads a column of soldiers along a cobbled street of old European houses, with smoke drifting over the town. Inside, shelves of books, a candle and a desk fill the room. The painting is an oil style, dark and warm, with no visible text and no frame.
